objects.description: Alias for std::string used across Rml for text data.
Alias for a vector of Rml::String values.

No custom types are defined in this header. It only contains a pragma once guard and includes another header (Debugger/Debugger.h). Types referenced from included headers are out of scope per the instructions.

Concrete UI element class for rendering SVG content within the Rml UI framework. Inherits from Element and provides SVG-specific sizing, rendering, and content management (inline SVG XML via GetInnerRML/SetInnerRML, or external source handled lazily via EnsureSourceLoaded). Holds internal SVG data state and a handle to parsed SVG::SVGData. Construction requires a tag name. Destruction is virtual via base. Details about lifetime of the handle and parsing are not shown in this header.

functions.name: Rml::MakeMoveIterator
functions.signature:
template <typename Iterator>
inline std::move_iterator<Iterator> Rml::MakeMoveIterator(Iterator it)
functions.description: Wraps an iterator in a std::move_iterator to enable move semantics on dereference. Use when transferring elements out of a range (e.g., moving into containers or algorithms) without copying.
requirements: Iterator must satisfy the requirements for std::make_move_iterator (i.e., a valid input/forward/random-access iterator type).
The passed iterator must be valid for dereferencing according to its iterator category when used.
Only use the returned move_iterator while the underlying range remains valid.
Moving from elements may leave them in a moved-from (but valid) state; callers must be prepared to handle that.

functions.name: Rml::MakeShared
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename... Args>
inline Rml::SharedPtr<T> Rml::MakeShared(Args&&... args)
functions.description: Convenience wrapper around std::make_shared that constructs an object of type T with the forwarded arguments and returns it as Rml::SharedPtr<T> (alias of std::shared_ptr<T>). Use to allocate shared-ownership objects with a single heap allocation.
requirements: T must be constructible from the provided Args... (i.e., std::is_constructible_v<T, Args...> must hold).
Construction of T may throw; callers should handle exceptions as appropriate.
Do not delete the returned pointer manually; ownership is managed by the shared pointer.
The lifetime of any references or pointers passed in Args must outlive their use in T's constructor if T stores them by reference/pointer.

functions.name: Rml::MakeUnique
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename... Args>
inline Rml::UniquePtr<T> Rml::MakeUnique(Args&&... args)
functions.description: Convenience wrapper around std::make_unique that constructs an object of type T with the forwarded arguments and returns it as Rml::UniquePtr<T> (alias of std::unique_ptr<T>). Use to create exclusive-ownership objects.
requirements: T must be constructible from the provided Args... (i.e., std::is_constructible_v<T, Args...> must hold).
Construction of T may throw; callers should handle exceptions as appropriate.
Do not delete the returned pointer manually; ownership is managed by the unique pointer.
The returned UniquePtr<T> must be the sole owner; transferring ownership requires moving the unique pointer.

functions.name: Rml::ElementSVG::GetInnerRML

requirements: content must be a valid reference to a mutable String to receive the SVG XML text.
Call does not modify object state (const).
Callers should not assume non-empty content; handle the empty-string case for file-sourced SVGs.

functions.name: Rml::ElementSVG::SetInnerRML
functions.description: Sets the SVG XML data (as text) for inline SVG content. Passing the text of the SVG sets the element’s inline source; an empty string effectively clears it.
requirements: rml should contain SVG XML text suitable for inline SVG; if empty, the inline content becomes empty.
rml must be a valid, null-terminated string.
Callers should expect that changing inline SVG may invalidate layout/geometry and trigger re-render (exact side effects unknown).

import random
import struct
import string
from typing import List

# This generator targets fuzz stubs that consume arbitrary strings via FUZZ_PARAM_STR.
# The stubs use the strings to construct and mutate std::string instances and move them
# between containers. Therefore, we focus on generating valid, interesting strings that
# exercise:
# - empty and very short strings
# - long strings (but <= 4096 bytes total output budget)
# - strings with varied character classes (ASCII, whitespace, punctuation)
# - multi-byte UTF-8 sequences
# - embedded NUL bytes and other control characters
# - repeated patterns and random data
# The returned bytes buffer will be split by the fuzzing harness to feed multiple
# FUZZ_PARAM_STR calls, so we include several strings separated by newlines as a simple
# and common delimiter. We ensure each part is valid arbitrary string data.

MAX_TOTAL = 4096

ASCII_PRINTABLE = string.ascii_letters + string.digits
PUNCT = "!@#$%^&*()-_=+[]{}|;:'\",.<>/?`~"
WHITESPACE = " \t\r\n\v\f"


def _utf8_codepoints() -> List[str]:
    # A curated set of UTF-8 sequences, including boundary cases and combining marks.
    samples = [
        "\u0000",  # NUL as unicode (will be encoded in UTF-8 later)
        "\u0001",
        "\u007f",  # DEL
        "\u00a0",  # non-breaking space
        "\u00ff",  # Latin-1 max
        "\u0100",  # start of Latin Extended-A
        "\u03b1",  # Greek alpha
        "\u0416",  # Cyrillic Zhe
        "\u0531",  # Armenian
        "\u05D0",  # Hebrew Alef
        "\u0627",  # Arabic Alef
        "\u0905",  # Devanagari A
        "\u0E01",  # Thai ko kai
        "\u1F600", # 😀 grinning face (4-byte UTF-8)
        "\u200B",  # zero width space
        "\u2028",  # line separator
        "\u2060",  # word joiner
        "\u20AC",  # Euro
        "\u221E",  # infinity
        "\u25A0",  # black square
        "\u2764",  # heart
        "\uFEFF",  # BOM
        "\u0301",  # combining acute accent
        "\u0308",  # combining diaeresis
    ]
    return samples


def _rand_ascii(rng: random.Random, length: int) -> bytes:
    pool = ASCII_PRINTABLE + PUNCT + WHITESPACE
    return ''.join(rng.choice(pool) for _ in range(length)).encode('utf-8', 'strict')


def _rand_bytes(rng: random.Random, length: int) -> bytes:
    return bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(length))


def _utf8_mixture(rng: random.Random, length: int) -> bytes:
    cps = _utf8_codepoints()
    out: List[str] = []
    while len(''.join(out).encode('utf-8')) < length:
        # mix ASCII chunks, punctuation, and selected codepoints
        choice = rng.randrange(4)
        if choice == 0:
            out.append(chr(rng.randrange(32, 127)))
        elif choice == 1:
            out.append(rng.choice(PUNCT))
        elif choice == 2:
            out.append(rng.choice(cps))
        else:
            # combining mark sequence
            base = rng.choice(['e', 'a', 'o', 'n', 'A', 'O'])
            comb = rng.choice(['\u0301', '\u0308'])
            out.append(base + comb)
    s = ''.join(out)
    b = s.encode('utf-8', 'strict')
    return b[:length]


def _with_nuls(data: bytes, rng: random.Random, count: int) -> bytes:
    if not data:
        return b"\x00" * count
    ba = bytearray(data)
    for _ in range(count):
        pos = rng.randrange(0, len(ba))
        ba[pos] = 0
    return bytes(ba)


def _pattern(rng: random.Random, base: bytes, total_len: int) -> bytes:
    if not base:
        base = b"A"
    reps = max(1, total_len // max(1, len(base)))
    s = (base * reps)[:total_len]
    return s


def _build_corpus(rng: random.Random) -> List[bytes]:
    parts: List[bytes] = []

    # 1) Edge cases: empty and tiny strings
    parts.append(b"")
    parts.append(b"a")
    parts.append(b"\n")
    parts.append(b" ")

    # 2) ASCII words with punctuation and whitespace
    parts.append(_rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(3, 32)))
    parts.append(_rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(10, 64)))

    # 3) UTF-8 mixture including multi-byte and combining marks
    parts.append(_utf8_mixture(rng, rng.randint(8, 64)))

    # 4) Random bytes chunk (still valid arbitrary string for std::string)
    parts.append(_rand_bytes(rng, rng.randint(4, 48)))

    # 5) Include embedded NULs
    nb = _rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(8, 40))
    parts.append(_with_nuls(nb, rng, rng.randint(1, min(4, max(1, len(nb)) ))))

    # 6) Repeated patterns to exercise append and move with larger content
    base = _utf8_mixture(rng, rng.randint(2, 8))
    parts.append(_pattern(rng, base, rng.randint(16, 128)))

    # 7) Boundary-like long strings but keep total under budget later
    long_candidate = _utf8_mixture(rng, rng.randint(128, 512))
    parts.append(long_candidate)

    # 8) Strings that look like XML/SVG snippets to be realistic for the library domain
    svg_snippet = (
        "<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"64\" height=\"64\">"
        "<rect x=\"0\" y=\"0\" width=\"64\" height=\"64\" fill=\"#" +
        ''.join(rng.choice('0123456789ABCDEF') for _ in range(6)) +
        "\"/><text x=\"4\" y=\"32\">fuzz</text></svg>"
    ).encode('utf-8')
    parts.append(svg_snippet)

    # 9) Control characters and separators
    controls = bytes([0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0x07, 0x08, 0x09, 0x0A, 0x0D, 0x1B])
    parts.append(controls + _rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(4, 16)))

    # 10) Another random bytes block with some zeros sprinkled
    rb = _rand_bytes(rng, rng.randint(16, 64))
    parts.append(_with_nuls(rb, rng, rng.randint(1, 6)))

    return parts


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    parts = _build_corpus(rng)

    # Shuffle to vary ordering per seed
    rng.shuffle(parts)

    # Join parts with newlines as separators; FUZZ_PARAM_STR is free-form so newlines are fine.
    # Ensure we stay under MAX_TOTAL.
    sep = b"\n"
    out = bytearray()
    for p in parts:
        # If adding this part would exceed MAX_TOTAL, truncate it to fit or stop if too small.
        if len(out) + len(sep) + len(p) > MAX_TOTAL:
            remaining = MAX_TOTAL - len(out)
            if remaining <= 0:
                break
            # Try to place a separator if space allows and it's not the first element
            if len(out) > 0 and remaining >= len(sep):
                out.extend(sep)
                remaining -= len(sep)
            if remaining > 0:
                out.extend(p[:remaining])
            break
        if len(out) > 0:
            out.extend(sep)
        out.extend(p)

    return bytes(out)

import random
from typing import List

# Generator for valid SVG XML text suitable for Rml::ElementSVG::SetInnerRML
# Goals:
# - Produce valid, well-formed XML with an <svg> root
# - Exercise a variety of SVG features while remaining small
# - Sometimes return empty string to exercise clearing inline content
# - Keep output size <= 4096 bytes

_XML_DECL = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n'

# Some helper pools
_COLORS = [
    "red", "green", "blue", "black", "white", "gray", "silver", "navy", "purple",
    "maroon", "olive", "teal", "aqua", "fuchsia", "orange", "brown"
]

_GRADIENT_STOPS = [
    (0, "#ff0000", 1.0),
    (50, "#00ff00", 0.8),
    (100, "#0000ff", 1.0),
]

_FILTERS = [
    "<feGaussianBlur in=\"SourceGraphic\" stdDeviation=\"{std}\"/>",
    "<feOffset dx=\"{dx}\" dy=\"{dy}\" result=\"off\"/><feBlend in=\"SourceGraphic\" in2=\"off\" mode=\"normal\"/>",
    "<feColorMatrix type=\"saturate\" values=\"{sat}\"/>",
]

_SHAPES_SIMPLE = [
    lambda r: f"<rect x='{r(0,90)}' y='{r(0,90)}' width='{r(5,200)}' height='{r(5,200)}' rx='{r(0,30)}' ry='{r(0,30)}' fill='{random.choice(_COLORS)}' stroke='{random.choice(_COLORS)}' stroke-width='{r(0,10)}'/>",
    lambda r: f"<circle cx='{r(5,200)}' cy='{r(5,200)}' r='{r(1,100)}' fill='{random.choice(_COLORS)}' stroke='{random.choice(_COLORS)}' stroke-width='{r(0,10)}'/>",
    lambda r: f"<ellipse cx='{r(5,200)}' cy='{r(5,200)}' rx='{r(1,120)}' ry='{r(1,80)}' fill='{random.choice(_COLORS)}'/>",
    lambda r: f"<line x1='{r(0,200)}' y1='{r(0,200)}' x2='{r(0,200)}' y2='{r(0,200)}' stroke='{random.choice(_COLORS)}' stroke-width='{r(1,8)}'/>",
]

_TEXT_SAMPLES = [
    "Hello, RmlUi!",
    "π≈3.14159 — SVG Text",
    "مرحبا SVG",
    "漢字テキスト",
    "Emoji 😀 SVG",
]

_PATH_CMDS = ["M", "L", "H", "V", "C", "S", "Q", "T", "A", "Z"]

def _randint(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return random.randint(a, b)


def _randfloat(a: float, b: float) -> float:
    return random.uniform(a, b)


def _maybe(prob: float) -> bool:
    return random.random() < prob


def _gen_gradient(def_id: str) -> str:
    if _maybe(0.5):
        # linear
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = _randint(0, 100), _randint(0, 100), _randint(0, 100), _randint(0, 100)
        stops = []
        for o, col, op in _GRADIENT_STOPS:
            stops.append(f"<stop offset='{o}%' stop-color='{col}' stop-opacity='{op}'/>")
        return f"<linearGradient id='{def_id}' x1='{x1}%' y1='{y1}%' x2='{x2}%' y2='{y2}%'>" + ''.join(stops) + "</linearGradient>"
    else:
        # radial
        cx, cy, r = _randint(0, 100), _randint(0, 100), _randint(10, 100)
        stops = []
        for o, col, op in _GRADIENT_STOPS:
            stops.append(f"<stop offset='{o}%' stop-color='{col}' stop-opacity='{op}'/>")
        return f"<radialGradient id='{def_id}' cx='{cx}%' cy='{cy}%' r='{r}%'>" + ''.join(stops) + "</radialGradient>"


def _gen_filter(def_id: str) -> str:
    tpl = random.choice(_FILTERS)
    content = tpl.format(std=round(_randfloat(0.1, 5.0), 2), dx=_randint(-10, 10), dy=_randint(-10, 10), sat=round(_randfloat(0.0, 2.0), 2))
    return f"<filter id='{def_id}'>{content}</filter>"


def _gen_path_d(max_cmds: int = 10) -> str:
    # Build a valid path with a move first
    cmds: List[str] = []
    x, y = _randint(0, 200), _randint(0, 200)
    cmds.append(f"M {x} {y}")
    for _ in range(_randint(1, max_cmds)):
        c = random.choice(_PATH_CMDS[:-1])  # avoid Z too often, add at end maybe
        if c == "L":
            cmds.append(f"L {_randint(0,200)} {_randint(0,200)}")
        elif c == "H":
            cmds.append(f"H {_randint(0,200)}")
        elif c == "V":
            cmds.append(f"V {_randint(0,200)}")
        elif c == "C":
            cmds.append(f"C {_randint(0,200)} {_randint(0,200)} {_randint(0,200)} {_randint(0,200)} {_randint(0,200)} {_randint(0,200)}")
        elif c == "S":
            cmds.append(f"S {_randint(0,200)} {_randint(0,200)} {_randint(0,200)} {_randint(0,200)}")
        elif c == "Q":
            cmds.append(f"Q {_randint(0,200)} {_randint(0,200)} {_randint(0,200)} {_randint(0,200)}")
        elif c == "T":
            cmds.append(f"T {_randint(0,200)} {_randint(0,200)}")
        elif c == "A":
            rx, ry = _randint(1, 100), _randint(1, 100)
            laf, sf = _randint(0, 1), _randint(0, 1)
            cmds.append(f"A {rx} {ry} {_randint(0,360)} {laf} {sf} {_randint(0,200)} {_randint(0,200)}")
    if _maybe(0.5):
        cmds.append("Z")
    return ' '.join(cmds)


def _gen_defs() -> str:
    parts: List[str] = []
    # Generate a few gradients/filters
    for i in range(_randint(0, 2)):
        parts.append(_gen_gradient(f"grad{i}"))
    for i in range(_randint(0, 2)):
        parts.append(_gen_filter(f"filt{i}"))
    if not parts:
        return ""
    return "<defs>" + ''.join(parts) + "</defs>"


def _gen_clip_path() -> str:
    if not _maybe(0.4):
        return ""
    x, y, w, h = _randint(0, 100), _randint(0, 100), _randint(20, 150), _randint(20, 150)
    return f"<clipPath id='clip1'><rect x='{x}' y='{y}' width='{w}' height='{h}'/></clipPath>"


def _gen_group_content() -> str:
    r = _randint
    parts: List[str] = []
    # simple shapes
    for _ in range(_randint(1, 4)):
        parts.append(random.choice(_SHAPES_SIMPLE)(r))
    # path
    if _maybe(0.8):
        fill = random.choice([random.choice(_COLORS), "none", "url(#grad0)", "url(#grad1)"])
        stroke = random.choice(_COLORS)
        parts.append(f"<path d='{_gen_path_d()}' fill='{fill}' stroke='{stroke}' stroke-width='{_randint(0,6)}'/>")
    # text
    if _maybe(0.7):
        txt = random.choice(_TEXT_SAMPLES)
        parts.append(
            f"<text x='{_randint(0,200)}' y='{_randint(10,200)}' font-size='{_randint(8,32)}' fill='{random.choice(_COLORS)}'" +
            (" filter='url(#filt0)'" if _maybe(0.5) else "") +
            f">{txt}</text>"
        )
    return ''.join(parts)


def _gen_viewBox(w: int, h: int) -> str:
    if _maybe(0.7):
        minx, miny = _randint(-50, 50), _randint(-50, 50)
        vbw, vbh = max(1, _randint(50, w*2)), max(1, _randint(50, h*2))
        return f" viewBox='{minx} {miny} {vbw} {vbh}'"
    return ""


def _gen_svg_root() -> str:
    # Sizes
    w = _randint(64, 512)
    h = _randint(64, 512)
    vb = _gen_viewBox(w, h)
    # Namespaces and optional title/desc
    title = "<title>Sample SVG</title>" if _maybe(0.5) else ""
    desc = "<desc>Generated for fuzz-init</desc>" if _maybe(0.3) else ""

    defs = _gen_defs()
    clip = _gen_clip_path()

    # Group with transforms, opacity, and optional clip/filter
    transforms = []
    if _maybe(0.6):
        transforms.append(f"translate({_randint(-50,50)} {_randint(-50,50)})")
    if _maybe(0.6):
        transforms.append(f"scale({_randfloat(0.3,2.5):.2f} {_randfloat(0.3,2.5):.2f})")
    if _maybe(0.6):
        transforms.append(f"rotate({_randint(0,360)})")
    tf = (" transform='" + ' '.join(transforms) + "'") if transforms else ""

    clip_attr = " clip-path='url(#clip1)'" if clip and _maybe(0.8) else ""
    filt_attr = " filter='url(#filt0)'" if ('filt0' in defs and _maybe(0.5)) else ""
    opacity = f" opacity='{_randfloat(0.3,1.0):.2f}'" if _maybe(0.5) else ""

    group_content = _gen_group_content()

    g = f"<g{tf}{clip_attr}{filt_attr}{opacity}>" + group_content + "</g>"

    # Optional <use> referencing gradients or clip
    use_parts = []
    if 'grad0' in defs and _maybe(0.5):
        use_parts.append("<rect x='0' y='0' width='50' height='50' fill='url(#grad0)'/>")
    if 'grad1' in defs and _maybe(0.3):
        use_parts.append("<circle cx='30' cy='30' r='20' fill='url(#grad1)'/>")

    bg = ""
    if _maybe(0.5):
        bg = f"<rect x='0' y='0' width='{w}' height='{h}' fill='{random.choice(_COLORS)}'/>"

    content = ''.join([title, desc, defs, clip, bg, g] + use_parts)

    svg_attrs = [
        f"xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'",
        f"width='{w}'",
        f"height='{h}'",
        f"version='1.1'",
    ]

    root = f"<svg {' '.join(svg_attrs)}{vb}>" + content + "</svg>"
    return root


def _maybe_empty() -> bool:
    # Return empty about 1/6 of the time to exercise clear behavior
    return _maybe(1/6)


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    random.seed(seed)

    if _maybe_empty():
        return b""  # Empty string clears inline SVG

    include_xml_decl = _maybe(0.5)
    svg = _gen_svg_root()
    xml = (_XML_DECL if include_xml_decl else "") + svg

    # Ensure size limit
    data = xml.encode('utf-8')
    if len(data) > 4096:
        # Trim safely at UTF-8 boundary by decoding back from slice
        cut = 4096
        while cut > 0 and (data[cut-1] & 0xC0) == 0x80:
            cut -= 1
        data = data[:cut]
        # Ensure we end with closing tag if possible; otherwise it's still valid UTF-8 but may be truncated XML.
        # To keep inputs valid, if we truncated, prefer regenerating a smaller SVG deterministically by reseeding.
        if cut < 4096:
            random.seed(seed ^ 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15)
            svg = _gen_svg_root()
            xml = (_XML_DECL if include_xml_decl else "") + svg
            data = xml.encode('utf-8')
            if len(data) > 4096:
                data = data[:4096]
    return data
